description: This file defines a JavaScript module 'SUGAR.mySugar' that manages dashboard dashlets in a CRM system. It includes functionalities for layout management, dashlet configuration, retrieval, addition, deletion, and UI interactions such as dialogs and category toggling.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the current layout of dashlets in each column, either as arrays or comma-separated strings.

methods.name: onDrag
methods.description: Records the layout state when a dashlet drag operation starts.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: Saves the new layout after a dashlet is dropped and reloads charts if layout changed.

methods.name: saveLayout
methods.description: Persists the dashboard layout to the server via an AJAX POST request.

methods.name: uncoverPage
methods.description: Handles the unmasking of the dashlet configuration dialog.

methods.name: configureDashlet
methods.description: Opens a configuration dialog for a specific dashlet, loading its configuration form.

methods.name: retrieveDashlet
methods.description: Loads and updates the content of a specified dashlet asynchronously.

methods.name: setChooser
methods.description: Stores the user's selection of display and hide columns for display configuration.

methods.name: deleteDashlet
methods.description: Removes a dashlet from the dashboard after user confirmation.

methods.name: addDashlet
methods.description: Adds a new dashlet to the dashboard, triggers its loading, and updates layout.

methods.name: retrieveCurrentPage
methods.description: Reloads the current dashboard page view.

methods.name: showDashletsDialog
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog to add or select dashlets.

methods.name: closeDashletsDialog
methods.description: Hides the dashlet selection dialog.

methods.name: toggleDashletCategories
methods.description: Switches visible dashlet categories (module, chart, tools, web).

methods.name: searchDashlets
methods.description: Performs an AJAX-based search for dashlets within categories.

methods.name: collapseList
methods.description: Collapses a UI list of items, such as charts.

methods.name: expandList
methods.description: Expands a previously collapsed list of items.

methods.name: collapseReportList
methods.description: Collapse a list of report charts.

methods.name: expandReportList
methods.description: Expand a list of report charts.

methods.name: clearSearch
methods.description: Resets the search input and toggles categories to default.

methods.name: doneAddDashlets
methods.description: Completes the addition of dashlets and hides the dialog.

methods.name: refreshPageForAnalytics
methods.description: Reloads the page, likely for updating analytics dashboards.

methods.name: renderDashletsDialog
methods.description: Creates and displays the dashboard dashlet selection dialog with dynamic sizing.
